title: Boyz II Men, Salt-N-Pepa and Bell Biv DeVoe Announce Joint Australasian Tour
text:
A major tour featuring three of the biggest '90s music acts-Boyz II Men, Salt-N-Pepa, and Bell Biv DeVoe-is set to tour Australia and New Zealand in late 2024, celebrating the era's R&B, hip-hop, and new jack swing legacy.
Boyz II Men, the iconic R&B quartet that dominated the 1990s, is set to embark on a major Australasian tour alongside fellow '90s legends Salt-N-Pepa and Bell Biv DeVoe.
This tour packages three of the decade's most influential acts for a series of concerts across Australia and New Zealand. Boyz II Men, now performing as a trio featuring Nathan Morris, Wanya Morris, and Shawn Stockman, stands as one of the most successful R&B groups in history. Their record-breaking chart achievements include five Billboard Hot 100 number-one hits.
Their song "One Sweet Day" with Mariah Carey held the top spot for a then-record 16 weeks, while "I'll Make Love To You" spent 14 weeks at number one and "End of the Road" reigned for 13 weeks. With over 64 million albums sold worldwide, four Grammy Awards, and a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame, their legacy is undeniable.
Salt-N-Pepa, comprising Cheryl "Salt" James, Sandra "Pepa" Denton, and DJ Spinderella, revolutionized hip-hop as the first female rap act to win a Grammy Award in 1995. Their catalog of groundbreaking hits includes "Push It," "Shoop," "Whatta Man" (with En Vogue), and "Let's Talk About Sex.
" Their accolades extend to a Grammy Lifetime Achievement Award in 2021 and a Hollywood Walk of Fame star, cementing their status as true pioneers who brought female empowerment and mainstream success to rap music. Bell Biv DeVoe, the trio of Ricky Bell, Michael Bivins, and Ronnie DeVoe, were central figures in the new jack swing movement, blending R&B with hip-hop.
Their 1990 debut album peaked at number five on the Billboard 200 and spawned major hits like "Poison" and "Do Me! ," both of which reached number three on the Billboard Hot 100. Their innovative sound and style left an indelible mark on '90s music and popular culture. The tour is produced by MG Live, Frontier Touring, and Arena Touring.
The concert series, part of the popular "a day on the green" outdoor concert brand, will span six dates across Australia and New Zealand. It kicks off on November 26 at Perth's RAC Arena and concludes on December 6 at Sirromet Wines at Mount Cotton in Queensland. Other stops include a Tuesday, December 1 performance at Spark Arena in Auckland and a Saturday, November 28 show at Mount Duneed Estate in Geelong.
Tickets for all dates go on sale Friday, July 17 at 11:00 AM local time
